line_ref_convention: 行号为 text/ch02_chapter_2.txt 的 1 基行号；引文逐字抄录

events.did: 在休伯特·布尔洛斯侯爵（Marquess of Kentmore）的书房里，看着堂姐妹 Clio 蹲下触碰死者外套边缘，探问死者灵魂是否留存
events.verbatim: Helena Blair looked from the very dead Marquess of Kentmore to her cousin, Clio. … ‘Does his spirit remain?’ Helena watched carefully as Clio Blair crouched in a daring leather corset and bright-green silk skirt to touch the edge of Lord Burrows’ jacket.

events.who: 克莱奥·布莱尔（Clio Blair）＋她的魔宠 Sir Robin（乌鸦）
events.did: 回答「他的灵魂没有留下，我什么都没感觉到」——|Clio 是能与亡灵对话并看见其记忆的火巫（firewitch）
events.verbatim: Sir Robin rubbed his sleek head against Clio’s cheek. ‘I don’t think his spirit remains. I feel… nothing.’ … Clio was a firewitch who could speak with ghosts and see their memories.

events.did: 因 Clio 娶了人、自己失去一个女巫团姐妹兼密友而失落；她评价 Grey「相当不错」，这点让她更恼火
events.verbatim: Clio would say she won as sparks scattered from her fingers and fire blazed in her amber eyes any time she mentioned her new husband, Lieutenant General Grey. … Helena would say she lost. … Grey was a rather decent fellow who obviously loved her cousin beyond all measure. Which was unaccountably annoying.

events.did: 在姑妈罗温的药剂铺「All Things Bright and Beautiful」帮柜台、Clio 在地下室的分工；两人只在店里清闲时聊天；她觉得像过了至少两周没见 Clio，其实只隔了两天
events.verbatim: It felt like Helena hadn’t seen her in at least a fortnight, though it had only been two days since they worked together at their aunt’s apothecary shop – All Things Bright and Beautiful.

events.did: 作为水巫（waterwitch），读心能力系于「河海相连、云地相连、思与行相连」的导电能量；读心是重责也是机会
events.verbatim: As a waterwitch, Helena’s powers were inherently tied to the conductive energy linking rivers to seas, clouds to the land, and thought to action. Reading minds was a heavy responsibility, but also a thrilling opportunity to discover the truth.

events.did: 列出辛西娅不可碰的四条理由：刚结婚（或到几小时前才守寡）、与她有姻亲关系、是规矩淑女、且是丈夫命案嫌疑人
events.verbatim: First, she was married – or at least, had been married until a few hours ago. Second, she was related to Helena – by marriage, but nonetheless. Third, she was a proper lady … Fourth, she was a suspect in her husband’s murder – which should probably rank first on Helena’s list.

events.did: 指母亲薇洛·布莱尔（Willow Blair）是她三个姐妹中最漂亮也最凶恶的一个——她知道美人同样能做出可怕之事
events.verbatim: Beautiful women were just as capable of horrendous deeds as anyone else. A fact Helena knew well thanks to her mother. Willow Blair had been the prettiest of her three sisters, and the most monstrous.

events.did: 拒绝承诺包庇有罪者：「她不是我的嫂子，也不是我的朋友；她若有罪我不会保护她」
events.verbatim: ‘She isn’t my sister-in-law. Nor is she my friend. I won’t protect her if she is guilty, Clio.’

events.who: 拉克兰舅舅（Uncle Lachlan）转述的现场事实
events.did: 四条事实：① 布尔洛斯死前夜与清晨都未待客；② 他习惯早起在书房工作到近中午才叫咖啡；③ 当早无人应召，是管家被辛西娅的尖叫引来；④ 几名女仆在尸体被发现前不到半小时听见辛西娅对管家说「我要杀了那个男人！」
events.verbatim: Uncle Lachlan had briefed Clio and Helena the moment they arrived. … Fact one: Lord Burrows had entertained no guests the night before or the morning of his death. Fact two: it was his habit to rise early and work in his office until mid-morning when he rang for coffee. Fact three: instead of being summoned by Lord Burrows that morning, the butler arrived to the frantic screams of Lady Burrows. Fact four: several maids heard Lady Burrows speaking with the housekeeper not half an hour before Lord Burrows was found dead. The phrase, ‘I’m going to kill that man!’ was distinctly heard.

events.did: 说自己相信辛西娅无罪、担心案件牵扯家人
events.verbatim: ‘I’m sorry, Clio. I know you hoped he might be able to help us identify the killer.’ And definitively prove Lady Burrows’ innocence. … Stealing away my family is one thing; killing her husband is quite another.

events.did: 在书桌后面发现一枚血迹斑斑的挂坠（红宝石中央缠着金蛇），叼给 Clio；Clio 骂了一声「Blast」
events.verbatim: Something glittered in his beak. Clio held out her hand. … A locket, rubies glinting in the centre with a golden snake wrapped around it, was marred by a crusted splattering of blood. The jewellery was far too expensive to belong to anyone but the lady of the house. ‘Blast,’ Clio muttered.

events.did: 海伦娜说「事实似乎正把矛头指向布尔洛斯夫人」；Clio 反驳「我们不知道这是她的，她丈夫出了名的不忠，也许属于某个情妇」
events.verbatim: Helena raised a copper brow at her cousin. ‘It would seem the facts are leading us to Lady Burrows.’ … ‘We don’t know this is hers. Her husband was notoriously unfaithful. Perhaps this belongs to one of his paramours.’

events.did: 带路去见布尔洛斯夫人，狐狸哈姆雷特紧跟其后
events.verbatim: Turning, Helena led the way to Lady Burrows’ front parlour, her fox faithfully slinking along at her heel.

events.did: 三人都由姑妈罗温带大；Clio 与 Ellie 是亲姐妹，但她们待海伦娜如亲妹妹，三人是一股强力忠诚的三股辫
events.verbatim: Clio, Ellie, and Helena had all been raised together by their Aunt Rowan. While Clio and Ellie were true sisters, they treated Helena like another sibling. … But they were also a powerful and loyal braid of three.

relationships_noted: 海伦娜 ↔ Clio：堂姐妹（cousin）；Clio 已嫁 Lieutenant General Grey（灵魂伴侣 spirit match）
Clio ↔ 辛西娅：Clio 称辛西娅为嫂子（sister-in-law）——因 Clio 嫁的是辛西娅的哥哥 Thomas（ch01:191 佐证）
海伦娜 ↔ 辛西娅：姻亲（by marriage），海伦娜是「嫌疑人」一侧的读心者
三人 ↔ 罗温姑妈：由姑妈带大；姑妈经营药剂铺 All Things Bright and Beautiful
三人 ↔ 拉克兰舅舅（Uncle Lachlan / MacDougal）：他奉命调她们来查案（ch02:107、:194）
海伦娜 ↔ 薇洛·布莱尔：母女；薇洛是她三个姐妹中最美也最凶的一个
海伦娜 ↔ 哈姆雷特（Hamlet）：魔宠，铜色尾巴的狐狸；Clio ↔ Sir Robin：魔宠，乌鸦
